title: TableDataSource
description:
Database table or view data source for querying data with filtering, searching, and sorting.
Implements ITableDataSource and IParametrizedDataSource<TableDataSourceParameter>.
Provides the most common data access pattern, supporting filters, search parameters, sorting,
and result paging. Table data sources map to database tables or views and support per-view configuration.

Filters.description:
Gets or sets the filter parameters applied to this data source.
Filters restrict results based on specific field conditions.
Key format: field name, Value: filter condition/value.
Example: { "Status": "Active", "Department": "Finance" }.

SearchParameters.description:
Gets or sets the search parameters for full-text or field-level search.
Used to search across multiple fields or perform text-based lookups.
Key format: field name or search type, Value: search term.
Example: { "FirstName": "John", "LastName": "Doe" }.

SortParameters.description:
Gets or sets the sort parameters that define result ordering.
Specifies which fields to sort by and sort direction.
Key format: field name, Value: "asc" or "desc".
Example: { "CreatedDate": "desc", "Name": "asc" }.

Parameters.description:
Gets or sets the list of table parameters that provide runtime values for filters, searches, and sorts.
Parameters support token substitution for component state, user claims, and pagination info.

Name.description: Gets the unique name identifier for this table data source. Used in component bindings.

Type.description: Gets the data source type. Can be DataSourceType.Table, LookupTable, or EditableGrid.

SingleResult.description:
Gets or sets whether this table returns a single result object rather than a collection.
When true, single-row results are unwrapped from array form.

AllowUnauthorizedAccess.description:
Gets or sets whether this table allows unauthenticated access.
When true, the table is queried without requiring authentication claims.

TableName.description:
Gets or sets the name of the database table or view that this data source queries.
Examples: "Users", "Approvals", "FormSubmissions".

SqlView.description:
Gets or sets the custom SQL view (CTE or derived query) to use instead of a direct table reference.
Allows for more complex filtering or transformation of the underlying table data.

ViewName.description:
Gets or sets the named view configuration for this table.
Views customize data retrieval behavior (filtering, sorting, search configuration).
Default is "default". Examples: "active", "archived", "summary".

ForwardPaginationParameters.description:
Gets or sets whether pagination parameters (page, pageSize, skip, take) should be forwarded to the table.
When true, component pagination settings are passed as table parameters for OFFSET/FETCH.

allOf.description:
Defines a table data source parameter for database table queries.
Extends DataSourceParameterBase with IsRequired flag and TableParameterDestinationType to determine
whether the parameter serves as a filter, search condition, or query parameter.

IsRequired.description:
Gets or sets whether this parameter is required by the table query.
When true, the parameter value must be provided or the query will fail.
When false, the query can execute without this parameter if not available in component state.

Type.description:
Gets or sets how this parameter is applied to the table data source.
Values: TableFilter (WHERE clause condition), TableSearch (full-text search), or Query (direct SQL parameter).
Default is TableFilter. Determines the SQL generation strategy used by the data source executor.

TableParameterDestinationType.description:
Specifies how a table parameter is applied when querying a database table or view.
JSON serialized as string values. Determines the SQL generation strategy used by the executor.

DataSourceParameterBase.description:
Base class for all data source parameter definitions.
Parameters define how external values (component state, user claims, pagination info) map to data source inputs.
Supports token substitution: ${componentName}, ${item.field}, ${User.attribute}, ~UserID, ~NOW.

SourceName.description:
Gets or sets the source location of the parameter value. Required.
Examples: component name, nested path (item.field), claim name.
Supports token syntax like "${itemValue}", "${User.Id}", "~UserID", "~NOW".

DestinationName.description:
Gets or sets the destination name for this parameter in the data source.
For API parameters: the OpenAPI parameter name.
For SQL parameters: the SQL parameter name (with or without @ prefix).
For Table parameters: the filter/search/query field name.
If not specified, defaults to the SourceName.

DataSourceType.description:
Specifies the type of data source, determining how data is fetched and processed.
JSON serialized as string values. Used to classify data sources and route to appropriate executors.
